verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent tracing documents opt-in capture of prompt and response content (the `data_collection` gen_ai key, `include_prompts`, `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs`). Nothing in the evidence says images, audio, or file payloads can be captured or rendered inside traces. Text prompt capture is an adjacent capability, not documented multimodal payload support, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
